title: Param-shape adaptor and runtime error playbook for function-call JSON
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Define a compact, implementation-friendly JSON param-shape grammar and an operational playbook for validation errors and compatibility handling when models invoke tools/functions. This ticket produces: a normative param-shape adaptor spec, runtime coercion rules, error code taxonomy, and a set of integration tests and a lightweight compatibility shim for older SDKs.

Background: We observed several production UIs degrade when function-call payloads changed shape (extra fields, stringified numbers, renamed optional keys). Teams need a predictable validation surface that balances correctness (preventing harmful calls) with developer ergonomics (lenient by default for backward compatibility).

Deliverables:
- Param-shape grammar (compact subset of JSON Schema focusing on types, enums, required, coercion hints) and examples for string/number/boolean/array/object cases.
- Runtime adaptor: config flags (compatibility_mode: strict|lenient|coerce), prioritized fallback (coerce -> warn -> reject), and clear logging hooks for Console.
- Error taxonomy and canonical error payloads for API consumers and SDKs (see codes list).
- Test matrix and QA checklist (integration tests, regression prompts, canary rollout plan).
- Implementation plan: small shim in inference runtime + SDK helpers for client-side preflight checks.

Key design decisions:
1) Use a reduced grammar that maps one-to-one to runtime validators to avoid divergent validator implementations across languages. The grammar will support a small set of explicit coercion hints (e.g., "coerce_from_string": true, "accept_null_as": "empty") to cover common model outputs.
2) Default compatibility_mode to "lenient" for existing customers; enterprise installs can pin to "strict" as part of release policies.
3) Errors are classified into five canonical codes: INVALID_TYPE, MISSING_REQUIRED, COERCION_FAILED, EXTRA_UNDECLARED_PARAM, ENUM_MISMATCH. Each error includes a human_message, machine_code, path, and optional example_fixes. (See error mapping section below.)
4) Reject only when running in strict mode or when coercion fails and the calling application has declared high risk (customer_impact = high). Otherwise, return a 202 with structured warnings and a best-effort mapped payload.

Error mapping examples (canonical JSON response snippet examples will be added to the PR):
- INVALID_TYPE: {machine_code: "INVALID_TYPE", path: "params.user.age", expected: "integer", received: "string"} 
- COERCION_FAILED: {machine_code: "COERCION_FAILED", path: "params.payment.amount", reason: "non-numeric string"} 
- EXTRA_UNDECLARED_PARAM: {machine_code: "EXTRA_UNDECLARED_PARAM", path: "params.debug", action: "dropped"}

Compatibility shim behavior:
- When compatibility_mode=coerce: attempt deterministic coercions in this order: number-from-string, string-from-number, boolean-from-string ("true"/"false"), null-to-empty for optional strings, single-item arrays unwrapped when target type is non-array. Log a COERCION_PERFORMED event tied to the request id.
- When compatibility_mode=lenient: coerce where safe, keep unknown fields but annotate them with warnings.
- When compatibility_mode=strict: apply validation strictly and return 400+structured error for the first failure.

Operational runbook highlights:
- Console: surface token-level count of COERCION_PERFORMED and top 10 MISSING_REQUIRED paths in the last 24h.
- Rollout: deploy validator behind a feature flag and run in observe-only mode for four days before enabling autofix/coerce.
- SDK: add a preflight validate_params() that mirrors server checks to detect issues earlier.

References and artifacts: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4892, Design doc (Confluence): https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENG/pages/32456/param-shape-adaptor

2025-02-14 - Marco N.: Reviewed coercion order and suggested adding telemetry hooks before any mutation. Agreed to tag COERCION_PERFORMED with request/trace ids. Task created to add tracing: ENG-167531.

2025-02-20 - QA: Identified regression where enum mismatch was silently coerced to first enum value. Decision: do not auto-coerce enums; instead fail or warn depending on mode. Added tests in runtime/tests/enum_coercion.test.ts.
2025-02-25 - Security review note: No customer secrets processed by the validator. Confirmed scope; security_review_required set to false. Audit event patterns documented for compliance team.
2025-03-01 - Marco N.: Implemented SDK preflight helper for JS and Go. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/221. Observability metrics emitted during canary in us-west-2.

2025-03-04 - Aisha P.: Running 48h observe-only canary; COERCION_PERFORMED volume is 3.1% of calls with most common path params.metadata.version (string->number). Next: add explicit user-facing guidance in Console and update docs.
